patterns.what_worked: Re-verifying the brief's own findings against the source before acting on them. Two of the three findings were real (L-2, L-4) and were closed with per-branch citations; the third (L-3) was based on a false premise and was refuted with citations rather than 'corrected'.
patterns.what_was_hard: Knowing when a brief's instruction is itself wrong and saying so with evidence instead of compliance. The brief said the bench file's citation was wrong; the citation was exactly right.
patterns.skill_gap: A dispatch brief is input, not authority - but saying 'your instruction is wrong' needs the same citation discipline as any other claim.
